text: Transparent DAO governance lets platforms compensate contributors according to demonstrated expertise and reputation, which mitigates the exploitative labor practices associated with centralized annotation services.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Artificial Intelligence The Final Frontier (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5095633
abstract: By implementing transparent governance mechanisms—often in the form of Decentralized Autonomous Organizations ("DAOs")—these ventures can equitably compensate data contributors based on demonstrated expertise and reputation, thus mitigating exploitative labor practices

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: governance is genuinely transparent and reputation is verifiable
